envelope.description: Add the two conversion roles and the provider helper

body.title: Add the two conversion roles and the provider helper
body.summary: Add tools.convert (peripheral, cheap) and tools.convert.escalate (peripheral, mid) to the closed registry in src/config/role-taxonomy.ts, and a small helper that builds ConversionProviders from an AnalyzeConfig, the repoPath and RoleRouter.resolveProviderForRole (src/analyze/context/role-router.ts:79). The coreFloor does not apply to them.
acceptanceChecks: both roles resolve through the RoleRouter at their default tiers and can be reassigned by roleTiers
the helper returns a provider for each role from a test config
existing role-taxonomy and role-router tests still pass

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/__tests__/conversion-roles.test.ts: the two new roles resolve through the real RoleRouter and role taxonomy, and the coreFloor does not clamp them
src/daemon/tools/__tests__/conversion-roles.test.ts: the helper returns a provider for each role from a test config
